meaning: Newly authored generic proposals; source-derived profile evidence stays separate

cards.title: List/detail task
cards.when: Locate an object, inspect it or act on it.
cards.avoid_when: Only a summary is needed, without object operations.
steps: Define the object and success
Design locate, inspect and return
Preserve filters and scroll context
checks: Empty collection differs from no results

worked_example.input: Find an order and inspect shipping
worked_example.choose: Locate it in a list, enter details and return
worked_example.reason: Paths complete tasks; card counts do not

cards.title: Recoverable form
cards.when: Submit structured data with possible input errors.
cards.avoid_when: No input or submission is necessary.
steps: Use native semantics first
Keep entered values and associate errors
Provide field navigation and appropriate summary focus

worked_example.choose: Link summary to the field and retain other values
worked_example.avoid: Show only a toast and clear the form
worked_example.reason: Feedback should help finish the task

cards.title: State coverage
cards.when: Data or permissions change available operations.
cards.avoid_when: Static images are being used to fabricate behavior.
steps: Separate initial empty, no results, loading and error
Implement states required by the actual task
Record unknown behavior rather than guessing

worked_example.avoid: Label a failed request as no data
worked_example.reason: Absence and retrieval failure require different actions

cards.title: Consequential operation
cards.when: A requested data action may be irreversible.
steps: Name objects and consequences
Reuse the product undo/confirmation mechanism
Keep success/failure understandable

worked_example.choose: Identify the draft and provide clear cancellation

cards.title: Dense data task
cards.when: Scan or compare many structured objects.
cards.avoid_when: Content is small or primarily narrative.
steps: Prioritize fields by task
Align comparable numbers with units
Test truncation/filtering/virtualization at real scale

worked_example.input: An order table shows amounts and states
worked_example.choose: Make numbers comparable; repeat state cues beyond color
worked_example.avoid: Replace every relation with equal-width cards

cards.title: Keyboard path
cards.when: The target platform supports keyboard input.
cards.avoid_when: A screenshot is being treated as keyboard evidence.
steps: Inspect native controls first
Execute the complete keyboard task
Check focus after closing overlays

worked_example.choose: Traverse controls and preserve return context
worked_example.avoid: Assume clickable divs work by keyboard
worked_example.reason: Pointer and keyboard are different behavior evidence

cards.title: Chart from the question
cards.keywords: chart graph data visualization trend comparison share
cards.when: Numbers must answer a specific question.
cards.avoid_when: One figure or a short table already answers it.
steps: Write the question the reader brings
Pick the form that answers it: line for change, bars for ranking, table for exact lookup
Label directly where possible, and do not rely on hue alone

worked_example.reason: Change over time is the question, and pies hide it

cards.title: Color by role
cards.keywords: color palette contrast theme dark semantic token
cards.when: Defining or extending colors for an interface.
cards.avoid_when: The reference already has measured colors covering the need.
steps: Name roles before values: surface, text, border, accent, status
Measure text and control contrast on each actual surface
Give status a second cue besides color
Treat dark mode as its own set of decisions, not an inversion
checks: Body text at 4.5:1 or better, large text and controls at 3:1 or better
Accent still rare enough to mean something

worked_example.input: Add an error state to a muted palette
worked_example.choose: A distinct error role plus an icon and message
worked_example.avoid: Red text alone at low contrast

cards.title: Choosing typefaces
cards.when: No reference type governs and a typeface must be chosen.
cards.avoid_when: Source typography already answers the role.
steps: List roles first, and use one family unless a role needs another
Set real copy in candidates at real sizes
Check glyph coverage, weights and license before committing
checks: Actual font rendered, with no silent fallback

worked_example.input: A dense report with long tables
worked_example.avoid: A display face for table cells

cards.title: Motion with a reason
cards.keywords: animation motion transition duration easing reduced
cards.when: A change of state or place is hard to follow without motion.
cards.avoid_when: Motion would only decorate, or would delay a repeated action.
steps: Name what the motion explains
Keep frequent feedback brief; let large moves take a little longer
Animate transform and opacity where possible
Provide a reduced-motion path

worked_example.input: A panel opens from a list row
worked_example.choose: A short move from that row
worked_example.avoid: A long bounce on every open
worked_example.reason: Origin explains the relation, and repetition punishes delay

cards.title: Fit the installed stack
cards.keywords: framework stack react vue version component library
cards.when: Adapting a design into an existing codebase.
steps: Read the installed versions and current components first
Reuse existing primitives before adding any
Check any snippet's dependencies before adapting it
checks: Works on the version actually installed

worked_example.input: Add a dialog to an app with a component library
worked_example.reason: The local primitive already handles focus and theme

cards.title: Waiting and result feedback
cards.keywords: loading progress skeleton success error toast feedback
cards.when: An action takes noticeable time or may fail.
cards.avoid_when: The result is instant and visible in place.
steps: Acknowledge the action immediately
Show progress in the place the result will appear
Report the outcome where the person is looking, with a next step on failure

worked_example.choose: Button shows progress, and errors sit by their fields
worked_example.avoid: A blocking spinner, then a vanishing toast
worked_example.reason: People need to know what happened and what to do next

cards.title: Touch and input reach
cards.keywords: touch target mobile tap gesture hover keyboard
cards.when: Controls will be used on touch or by mixed input.
cards.avoid_when: Pointer-only desktop tools with a stated constraint.
steps: Keep touch targets near 44 by 44 points, even when the visible mark is smaller
Separate adjacent risky actions
Never leave an action available on hover only
Offer a visible path for any gesture
checks: Reachable with one hand where expected

worked_example.input: A row with edit and delete icons
worked_example.choose: Enlarged hit areas, with delete apart and undoable
